t: 朝廷官员郭威领导了军事政变,并宣布自己为"后周"的皇帝.
te: Guo Wei, a court official, leads a military coup and declares himself emperor of the new Later Zhou.
dz: 朝廷官员郭威领导了军事政变,并宣布自己为"后周"的皇帝.
de: Guo Wei, a court official, leads a military coup and declares himself emperor of the new Later Zhou.

dz: 南唐皇帝李璟派边镐率领一万人的远征军征服楚国。李璟将楚国统治家族迁至自己的都城南京，楚国至此灭亡。
de: Emperor Li Jing sends a Southern Tang expeditionary force of 10,000 men under Bian Hao to conquer Chu. Li Jing removes the ruling family to his own capital in Nanjing, ending the Chu Kingdom.
